import json, re, random, sys, time
import chess

RULES = json.load(open("re.json"))


def solve(fen):
    for p, r in RULES:
        fen = re.sub(p, r, fen)
    return fen.split("\n")


def expected(board):
    s = set()
    for m in board.legal_moves:
        if m.promotion and m.promotion != chess.QUEEN:
            continue
        b = board.copy()
        b.push(m)
        s.add(" ".join(b.fen().split(" ")[:-2]))
    return s


def check(fen):
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    exp = expected(board)
    got = [" ".join(x.split(" ")[:-2]) for x in solve(fen)]
    ok = len(got) == len(exp) and all(x in exp or x.rpartition(" ")[0] + " -" in exp for x in got)
    if not ok:
        print("FAIL", fen)
        print(" got-exp", sorted(set(got) - exp))
        print(" exp-got", sorted(exp - set(got)))
        print(len(got), len(exp))
    return ok


sample = "rnb1k1nr/p2p1ppp/3B4/1p1NPN1P/6P1/3P1Q2/P1P5/q4Kb1 w kq - 0 1"
print(solve(sample))
check(sample)
random.seed(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 0)
n = fails = 0
t = time.time()
for g in range(int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 300):
    b = chess.Board()
    while not b.is_game_over() and b.ply() < 200:
        if b.turn == chess.WHITE and any(True for _ in b.legal_moves):
            n += 1
            if not check(b.fen()):
                fails += 1
                if fails > 5:
                    sys.exit(1)
        moves = list(b.legal_moves)
        # bias towards captures/pawn moves/castling for variety
        b.push(random.choice(moves))
print("tested", n, "fails", fails, "time", time.time() - t)
